evals.name: fresh-setup
evals.prompt: This is my let-go CLI project 'gizmo' (built with lgx). I want people to be able to install it with Homebrew, and I want releases to happen automatically when I tag a version. The GitHub repo is github.com/acme/gizmo. Please set that up.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds scripts/generate-formula.sh (executable, class Gizmo, homepage/urls acme/gizmo, bin.install gizmo), scripts/tag.lg, .github/workflows/checks.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml (with a homebrew job pushing Formula/gizmo.rb to acme/homebrew-tap, smoke test 'gizmo --version'), resources/VERSION (0.1.0, no trailing newline). Edits main.lg to read the version from the resource and lgx.edn to add :resource-paths and a release task. Adds a README Installation section with 'brew install acme/tap/gizmo'. No @@ placeholders remain. Surfaces the manual steps (homebrew-tap repo, HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN secret).
expectations: scripts/generate-formula.sh exists and is executable
generate-formula.sh declares 'class Gizmo < Formula' and uses bin.install "gizmo"
generate-formula.sh homepage and download URLs point at github.com/acme/gizmo
scripts/tag.lg exists and reads resources/VERSION
.github/workflows/release.yml exists and contains a 'homebrew:' job
release.yml pushes Formula/gizmo.rb to the acme/homebrew-tap repo
release.yml smoke-tests the binary with 'gizmo --version' (not a nonexistent subcommand)
.github/workflows/checks.yml exists
resources/VERSION contains exactly '0.1.0' with no trailing newline
main.lg reads the version via (io/resource "VERSION") instead of a hardcoded string
lgx.edn contains :resource-paths ["resources"] and a release task that runs scripts/tag.lg
README has an Installation section containing 'brew install acme/tap/gizmo'
No '@@' placeholder markers remain in any scaffolded file
The response tells the user to create the homebrew-tap repo and add a HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN secret

evals.name: existing-ci
evals.prompt: Add automated Homebrew releases to my lgx project 'gizmo' (repo: acme/gizmo). Heads up: I already have a GitHub Actions checks workflow I'm happy with, so don't overwrite it.
evals.expected_output: Adds the release pipeline (scripts/generate-formula.sh, scripts/tag.lg, release.yml with the homebrew job for Formula/gizmo.rb, resources/VERSION) and wires main.lg/lgx.edn, but leaves the existing .github/workflows/checks.yml untouched (its distinctive marker comment survives). release.yml's checks job still references ./.github/workflows/checks.yml.
files: PLUS a pre-existing .github/workflows/checks.yml carrying the marker comment '# gizmo project CI - keep me'
expectations: The pre-existing .github/workflows/checks.yml is preserved (its '# gizmo project CI - keep me' marker still present)
scripts/generate-formula.sh exists (executable) with 'class Gizmo' and bin.install "gizmo"
scripts/tag.lg exists
.github/workflows/release.yml exists with a 'homebrew:' job pushing Formula/gizmo.rb
release.yml's checks job references ./.github/workflows/checks.yml
resources/VERSION contains exactly '0.1.0' with no trailing newline
No '@@' placeholder markers remain in any scaffolded file
